sermon.title: Guilty but Innocent— July 12, 2020
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer looks at Absalom, who promised justice without authority and stole Israel’s hearts. He compares this to today’s “new tolerance” and false justice that makes evil equal with good. True justice is impartial and punishes evildoers. America is in a war of good and evil, but Jesus will establish justice, and informed believers must do their part.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: What is justice?
faqs.answer: Finding people who harm themselves and others guilty, and honoring innocent people who are not guilty.

faqs.question: What war compares to America today?
faqs.answer: The war in Samuel between Absalom and David — a war between good and evil.
